$comment: UniqBrio — academy management (UniqBrio/UniqBrio-Mobile-App, an Expo Router PWA). Registered for
coverage and page audits on 2026-10-22. Sign-in selectors are the app's own test ids (app/login.tsx):
mobile → Get OTP → 4-digit OTP → Verify. baseUrl is TEST_APP_URL from UniqBrio_App_Screenshot_Capture.
Its twelve legacy flows there are Phase-1 placeholders written for a different engine (several write
data through a cleanup module this engine does not have) and were NOT ported: port each one through
`npm run validate` once its selectors are verified. Read-only: dataIsolation none.
The app repo is PRIVATE: CI needs a read token to audit it (see README, 'Apps in separate repositories').
appDescription: Academy management for arts and sports academies: students, attendance, fees, staff and enquiries.
